scripts.text:
[Mr. Jass]
You're too greedy, even compared to someone like me!
Why don't you go lighten your bag first?
scripts.translation:
[贾斯先生]
你太贪心了，连我都要自愧不如了！
你先把背包腾出点空间再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jass]
Hey, you already made a contract with Hugh.
I don't have any business with you.
scripts.translation:
[贾斯先生]
嘿，你已经和休签了契约。
我可没空搭理你。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jass]
You must need something badly to come to find me.
What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[贾斯先生]
你一定是急需什么东西才会来找我。
说吧，你想要什么？

scripts.text: Bulk Buyer Shop License
scripts.translation: 简易采购商店执照

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？

scripts.text: Nothing, nothing!
scripts.translation: 没什么，没什么！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jass]
I knew it!
Sure, I can make it for you.
Mine looks just like the authentic one that Merchants get from that bastard Mr. Hugh!
scripts.translation:
[贾斯先生]
我就知道！
行，我可以帮你做。
我做的和那个混蛋休先生给商人的正品一模一样！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jass]
And my license is better 'cuz you don't need ta' learn any skills.
How many do you want?
scripts.translation:
[贾斯先生]
而且我的执照更好，因为你不需要学任何技能。
你要多少？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jass]
Just so you know, I can only make them in small quantities, up to 10 at a time.
It'll cost 500 zeny for each one.
scripts.translation:
[贾斯先生]
提醒你一下，我一次最多只能做10个。
每个要500 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jass]
Don't you need those licenses?
scripts.translation:
[贾斯先生]
你不需要那些执照吗？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jass]
I can only make up to 10 at a time, you know.
scripts.translation:
[贾斯先生]
我一次最多只能做10个，你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jass]
It'll cost {0} zeny.
but you don't have enough money.
scripts.translation:
[贾斯先生]
需要{0} Zeny。
但你钱不够。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jass]
It'll cost {0} zeny.
Ha... Ha ha ha!
Mr. Hugh, I'll take over your license business. You'll see!
*Giggle Giggle*
scripts.translation:
[贾斯先生]
需要{0} Zeny。
哈...哈哈哈！
休先生，我要接管你的执照生意。走着瞧吧！
*咯咯咯咯*

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jass]
Don't you know the basics of business? Everything has a price.
If you want something, you gotta pay for it.
scripts.translation:
[贾斯先生]
你连做生意的基本常识都不懂吗？万物皆有价。
想要东西，就得付钱。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jass]
I left my hometown a long time ago.
It's meaningless to ask who I am because all I've got left now is my hatred.
scripts.translation:
[贾斯先生]
我很久以前就离开家乡了。
问我是谁没有意义，因为我现在剩下的只有仇恨。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jass]
...
Hugh is a corrupt merchant with no sense of business ethics.
My sole purpose in life is to destroy Hugh.
scripts.translation:
[贾斯先生]
...
休是个没有商业道德的腐败商人。
我活着的唯一目的，就是毁掉休。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jass]
Aw, I drank too much... (*Hic*)
That's just the alohol talking.
Please forget anything I said.
scripts.translation:
[贾斯先生]
哎呀，我喝多了...（打嗝）
那只是酒话。
请忘掉我刚才说的一切。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Jass]
Alright, alright! You don't have to yell.
Just leave me alone if you've got no business with me.
scripts.translation:
[贾斯先生]
好了好了！你不用吼。
如果你没正事，就让我一个人待着。

scripts.text: - You cannot converse or perform the quest because you are carrying too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于你携带的物品过多，无法对话或执行任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Mr. Hugh]
I'm Hugh from the Purchasing Team.
How may I help you today?
scripts.translation:
[休先生]
我是采购组的休。
今天有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Hugh]
I'm Hugh from the Purchasing Team at the Alberta Merchant Guild.
You're...
scripts.translation:
[休先生]
我是艾尔贝塔商人公会采购组的休。
你是...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Hugh]
I'm Hugh from the Purchasing Team at the Alberta Merchant Guild.
I'd love to chat, but I'm too busy at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[休先生]
我是艾尔贝塔商人公会采购组的休。
我很想和您聊聊，但现在实在太忙了。

scripts.text: Purchase Bulk Buyer Shop License
scripts.translation: 购买简易采购商店执照

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Mr. Hugh]
Please feel free to ask me if you need any Bulk Buyer Shop Licenses.
Come again~
scripts.translation:
[休先生]
如果您需要简易采购商店执照，请随时向我咨询。
欢迎再来~

scripts.text:
[Mr. Hugh]
It's 200 zeny for each Bulk Buyer Shop License, and you may purchase up to 50 at a time.
How many licenses do you need?
scripts.translation:
[休先生]
每张简易采购商店执照200 Zeny，一次最多可购买50张。
您需要多少张执照？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Hugh]
You have cancelled the trade.
Have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[休先生]
您已取消交易。
祝您有美好的一天。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Hugh]
Please enter a value of 50 or less.
scripts.translation:
[休先生]
请输入50或以下的数值。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Hugh]
It'll cost {0} zeny for {1} licenses.
but you don't seem to have enough money.
scripts.translation:
[休先生]
{1}张执照需要{0} Zeny。
但您似乎资金不足。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Hugh]
It'll cost {0} zeny for {1} licenses.
Thank you for your patronage.
scripts.translation:
[休先生]
{1}张执照需要{0} Zeny。
感谢您的惠顾。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Hugh]
Did you know? Our guild has issued a license to allow individuals to buy goods from others.
scripts.translation:
[休先生]
您知道吗？我们的公会已经颁发了执照，允许个人向他人购买物品。

scripts.text: I've never had problems buying items...
scripts.translation: 我买东西从来没遇到过问题...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Hugh]
You're right, but think about it:
haven't you had a hard time buying in bulk?
You'd have to find and talk to everyone that has an item you want.
Pretty inconvenient, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[休先生]
您说得对，但请想一想：
您是否曾觉得批量购买很困难？
您必须找到并联系每一个拥有您想要物品的人。
这不是很麻烦吗？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Hugh]
Since buying in bulk is an important issue to us Merchants,
I've proposed an innovative plan to our guild, based on my 10 years of experience in making purchases.
scripts.translation:
[休先生]
既然批量购买对我们商人来说是个重要问题，
我就基于自己10年的采购经验，向公会提出了一个创新方案。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Hugh]
'Let Individuals Open
a Bulk Buyer Shop!'
That's the title of my proposal.
You'll see, when you read it...
scripts.translation:
[休先生]
“让个人开设简易采购商店！”
这就是我的提案标题。
您一看就会明白...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Hugh]
...
...(Mr. Hugh yammers on and on with all the details.)
scripts.translation:
[休先生]
...
...（休先生喋喋不休地讲述着所有细节。）

scripts.text: Alright, what's your point?
scripts.translation: 好了，你的重点是什么？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Hugh]
Oh, yes. In summary,
you can buy certain items in bulk through Vending.
scripts.translation:
[休先生]
哦，是的。简而言之，
您可以通过露天商店批量购买特定物品。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Hugh]
In order to open a Bulk Buyer Shop, you need a license issued from the Merchant Guild.
scripts.translation:
[休先生]
要开设简易采购商店，您需要商人公会颁发的执照。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Hugh]
You need it every time you open the shop. We're expecting a significant increase in profits through this new kind of licensing.
scripts.translation:
[休先生]
每次开设商店都需要执照。我们预计通过这种新的执照制度，利润会有显著增长。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Hugh]
That's the point of my proposal!
Our president was so happy to hear that we're going to make big bucks!
scripts.translation:
[休先生]
这就是我的提案要点！
我们的会长听说我们要赚大钱，高兴极了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please get to the point already!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
请快点说重点！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Hugh]
Don't be so impatient, alright?
My point is, we can let you open the Bulk Buyer Shop if you've learned Vending.
scripts.translation:
[休先生]
别这么着急嘛。
我的意思是，如果你学会了露天商店技能，我们就能让你开设简易采购商店。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Hugh]
Of course, we charge 10,000 zeny as a one-time registration fee.
You will need the ^4A4AFFBulk Buyer Shop License^000000 every time you open the shop.
scripts.translation:
[休先生]
当然，我们需要收取10,000 Zeny的一次性注册费。
每次开设商店时，您都需要使用^4A4AFF简易采购商店执照^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Hugh]
Say, would you like to register now?
If you do, I'll teach you how to open the Bulk Buyer Shop.
scripts.translation:
[休先生]
请问，您现在要注册吗？
如果愿意的话，我会教您如何开设简易采购商店。

scripts.text: Learn how to open Bulk Buyer Shop
scripts.translation: 学习如何开设简易采购商店

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Mr. Hugh]
Man, that's disappointing!
Using this bulk buyer option can benefit your business in many ways, but it's your call.
I'm always open for consultation!
scripts.translation:
[休先生]
哎呀，真让人失望！
使用这个批量购买功能可以在很多方面助您的生意一臂之力，但这由您决定。
我随时欢迎您来咨询！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Hugh]
The registration fee is 10,000 zeny.
Please have the fee ready first.
scripts.translation:
[休先生]
注册费是10,000 Zeny。
请先准备好这笔费用。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Hugh]
You've made a good decision.
Please give me the registration fee, and sign right here....
scripts.translation:
[休先生]
您做了一个明智的决定。
请支付注册费，并在这里签字...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Hugh]
{0}....
I like your handwriting.
Okay, you're now approved to open the Bulk Buyer Shop.
scripts.translation:
[休先生]
{0}...
您的字迹真不错。
好了，您现在已获准开设简易采购商店。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Hugh]
Currently, only normal items ^8C2121EXCEPT^000000 equipment, certain potions, and hand-crafted items can be purchased in bulk, but this can still be very beneficial to you, depending on how you use it.
scripts.translation:
[休先生]
目前，除了^8C2121装备^000000、特定药水以及手工制作的物品外，其他普通物品都可以批量购买。根据您如何使用它，这将对您非常有益。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Hugh]
Oh, and you need at least one of the item that you want to buy in your inventory because you have to show it to other through your shop.
scripts.translation:
[休先生]
哦，对了，您的物品栏中必须至少有一件您想要购买的物品，因为您必须通过商店向其他人展示它。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Hugh]
Your skill should now be registered in your skill window. If you can't see it you probably have to minimize your Skill List and check the 3rd Job Tab.
scripts.translation:
[休先生]
您的技能现在应该已经注册在技能窗口中了。如果您看不到它，可能需要最小化技能列表，并检查第三转职标签页。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Hugh]
I've given you 5 Bulk Buyer Shop Licenses for your trial.
Enjoy shopping!
scripts.translation:
[休先生]
我给了您5张简易采购商店执照供您试用。
祝您购物愉快！

scripts.text:
I'm Hugh from the Purchasing Team at the Alberta Merchant Guild.
I'd love to chat, but I'm too busy at the moment.
scripts.translation:
我是艾尔贝塔商人公会采购部的休。
我很乐意和您聊天，但现在实在太忙了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Hugh]
My time is solely dedicated to our customers in the Merchant industry.
scripts.translation:
[休先生]
我的时间完全奉献给商人行业的客户们。
